// diagnostic E3012

Jet.StackOverflow

Stack overflow in `{fn_name}`

What

Stack overflow in `{fn_name}`

Why

The call stack kept growing without reaching a safe return — with Jet file, line, and source context

Fix

End the recursion or make progress toward a base case, or give deep work more stack with `task.group deep(stack: bytes)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.StackOverflow: Tests/UI/E3012_comptime_stack_overflow_names_its_function.stderr.

Error: Jet.StackOverflow: Stack overflow in `deep`
  --> Tests/UI/E3012_comptime_stack_overflow_names_its_function.jet:3:13
    |
  3 | LIMIT: #run deep(0)
    |             ^^^^
 Why: Compile-time code kept calling deeper without returning until it ran out of stack, so the `#run` value has no result
 Fix: End the recursion or make each call progress toward a base case, or compute the value at run time
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.StackOverflow
